Stage 5: Volcano + Enrichment Plots

Bo Yu, Si Liu, Wei Sun

2026-02-27

Load experiment object

library(jaxExperiment)

expt_file = file.path("outputs", "experiment.rds")
expt = load_experiment(expt_file)
expt

Volcano plots (saved to PNG)

spec5 = stage5_spec_default()
expt = stage5_write_volcano_plots(expt, spec = spec5)
## Stage5 volcano plots:
##   - Contrasts: 5
##   - Cutoffs: |log2FC| > 0.585, padj < 0.05
##   - Output dir: outputs/figures/volcano_plots
## 
##   - ELK3_PTC @ ExM_day6_nor_ELK3_SNAI2_SOX7: genes=22593, padj_NA=6583, log2FC_NA=0, padj_0=0, plotted=16010
##   - SNAI2_PTC @ ExM_day6_nor_ELK3_SNAI2_SOX7: genes=22593, padj_NA=5712, log2FC_NA=0, padj_0=0, plotted=16881
##   - SOX7_PTC @ ExM_day6_nor_ELK3_SNAI2_SOX7: genes=22593, padj_NA=8330, log2FC_NA=0, padj_0=0, plotted=14263
##   - TFEB_PTC @ PrS_day6_nor_TFEB_ZNF175: genes=22600, padj_NA=5262, log2FC_NA=0, padj_0=0, plotted=17338
##   - ZNF175_PTC @ PrS_day6_nor_TFEB_ZNF175: genes=22600, padj_NA=7451, log2FC_NA=0, padj_0=0, plotted=15149
## Stage5 volcano plots: wrote 5 PNG file(s).
rep5 = stage5_report(expt)
## Stage5 report:
##   - Volcano PNGs: 5
##   - GOSEQ PNGs: 0
##   - Enrichment labels: 0
if (nrow(rep5$volcano_files) > 0) {
  knitr::include_graphics(rep5$volcano_files$file)
}

Enrichment (goseq) plots (saved to PNG)

expt = stage5_run_goseq(expt, spec = spec5)
## Stage5 enrichment (goseq):
##   - Contrasts: 5
##   - DE rule: padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.585
##   - Gene-set size filter: 10 to 500
##   - Diagnostic PWF (bias) plot: disabled (goseq::nullp plot of bias data in ~1500 bins vs proportion DE)
## 
## Stage5 enrichment (goseq): produced results for 10 contrast-direction label(s).
expt = stage5_write_goseq_plots(expt, spec = spec5)
## Stage5 goseq plots:
##   - Labels: 8
##   - Output dir: outputs/figures/goseq_plots
## Stage5 goseq plots: wrote 8 PNG file(s).
rep5 = stage5_report(expt)
## Stage5 report:
##   - Volcano PNGs: 5
##   - GOSEQ PNGs: 8
##   - Enrichment labels: 10
if (nrow(rep5$goseq_files) > 0) {
  knitr::include_graphics(rep5$goseq_files$file)
}

rep5 = stage5_report(expt)
## Stage5 report:
